meta.note: Each asset carries 20 annual total-return percentages for 2006..2025. Index level is rebased so baseYear = 100. Every series is nominal USD; real returns are computed against the CPI series at runtime.

assets.name: S&P 500
assets.source: S&P Dow Jones Indices annual total returns
assets.caveat: Pre-tax and pre-fee. An index fund tracking it costs roughly 0.03-0.2%/yr.

assets.name: US Housing
assets.blurb: S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller national home price index.
assets.source: Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index, year-end levels
assets.caveat: Price appreciation ONLY. Excludes rent/imputed rent on the upside, and property tax, insurance, maintenance, transaction costs and mortgage interest on the downside. Real-world owner returns differ substantially, in both directions.

assets.name: Gold
assets.blurb: Spot bullion, USD per troy ounce.
assets.caveat: No yield. Physical holding adds storage/insurance cost; ETFs charge ~0.2-0.4%/yr.

assets.name: Cash
assets.source: 3-month Treasury bill secondary market rate, annual average
assets.caveat: The benchmark for 'doing nothing'. Note how badly it loses to CPI in 2021-2023.

assets.name: Watches
assets.blurb: Collectible wristwatches - Rolex, Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet - on the secondary market.
assets.source: Reconstructed to track the Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index watch component
assets.caveat: The 2021-22 spike and the 2023-24 give-back are real and well documented; the individual annual figures are my reconstruction, not published values.

assets.name: Handbags
assets.blurb: Hermes-led collectible handbags, principally Birkin and Kelly.
assets.source: Reconstructed to track the Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index handbag component
assets.caveat: The steadiest luxury category - low drawdowns, modest upside. Annual figures are reconstructed.

assets.name: Jewellery
assets.blurb: Signed period and contemporary jewellery at auction.
assets.source: Reconstructed to track the Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index jewellery component

assets.name: Classic Cars
assets.source: Reconstructed to track the Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index classic car component
assets.caveat: The 2010-2015 boom and the flat decade that followed are the real shape. Excludes storage, insurance, maintenance and restoration, which are material for cars specifically.

assets.name: Art
assets.blurb: Fine art at auction, across categories.
assets.source: Reconstructed to track the Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index art component
assets.caveat: The sharp 2024 decline is real and widely reported. Auction indices suffer survivorship bias - works that fail to sell often leave the index.

assets.name: Fine Wine
assets.source: Reconstructed to track fine wine indices (Liv-ex family) and the Knight Frank wine component
assets.caveat: The 2011 peak, the 2012-14 correction and the 2023-24 slump are real. Annual figures are reconstructed.

assets.name: Rare Whisky
assets.blurb: Collectible single malt, principally Macallan and closed distilleries.
assets.source: Reconstructed to track rare whisky indices and the Knight Frank whisky component
assets.caveat: The best-performing luxury asset of the 2010s and the worst of 2023-24. A dramatic boom-bust that flatters or damns it entirely depending on your start year - the single clearest argument for the window selector.

assets.name: Coloured Diamonds
assets.source: Reconstructed to track the Knight Frank Luxury Investment Index coloured diamond component
assets.caveat: Famously illiquid and opaquely priced; the low volatility here is partly an artefact of infrequent repricing rather than genuine stability.

assets.name: Instruments
assets.blurb: Vintage musical instruments — fine violins, pre-CBS Fenders, burst Les Pauls, Mark VI saxophones.
assets.source: Reconstructed to track published vintage-instrument indices and auction results
assets.caveat: A thin, highly condition-sensitive market. An original-finish instrument can be worth twice a refinished one, which the category average cannot express. Annual figures are reconstructed.

cpi.name: US CPI-U
cpi.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, annual average inflation
